key_observations_html:
• Crypto total market cap fell 7.6% over 30D: Total crypto market cap at $2.80T (7.6% lower over 30D) points to a risk-off or digestive market—capital is more selective, and plumbing stories matter more than beta chase. Related: OCC calls on community banks to enter the stablecoin payments market (CoinDesk).
  • Losses broadened among top-50 alts: 4 names up more than ~0.5%, 33 down more than ~0.5%, and 4 roughly flat out of 41 non-stable coins with a valid 1M % (top-50 table). Related: ARB Touches Four-Week Low as Losses Outpace Bitcoin and Ether (The Defiant).
  • Regulatory framing still decides product access: Enforcement and legislation shocks tend to pull risk into majors first, while higher-beta categories retrace until policy clarity returns. Related: Canada opens consultation on draft stablecoin rules, maintains ban on yields (CoinDesk).
  • Listed ETF flows remain the cleanest demand gauge: Listed-product demand usually hits Bitcoin first, then filters into broader market beta if primary-market creations stay firm. Related: Bitcoin ETFs break 2-week outflow streak with $301M comeback (CoinTelegraph).
